reasoning: Plan A is the better training plan for a trail runner aiming to become faster. While Plan B focuses heavily on aerobic base building with longer, steady-state runs, Plan A includes shorter, more frequent runs that can contribute to improved speed and efficiency. The inclusion of varied distances within the easy runs also allows for a more nuanced approach to building fitness, rather than just consistently increasing volume.
